name: tsh-product-management
description: The business-analysis workflow end to end: discovery workshop materials — transcripts, Figma, PDFs, codebase context — become Jira-ready epics and user stories, a per-product domain dictionary and an outcome-based delivery roadmap, behind five human review gates, with a hook that, while a business-analysis session is open in the repository, refuses Jira writes to a project until the push gate is approved for that project. Also imports an existing Jira backlog for local iteration, and sets up a project's knowledge base — a `<project>-context` repository every code repository and role reads with cited sources and changes only through a branch and a pull request, with a second hook that guards its pointer in CLAUDE.md. Seven read-only worker subagents keep the heavy reading out of the conversation.
